caveats: 677 open finding(s) carry no lane this router understands and are NOT dispatched. They are not a backlog of easy work — they are unrouted, and a default lane would hand physics to an infra worker. Run `uv run python scripts/backfill_lanes.py --propose` and work the proposals.

37 dispatchable finding(s) declare NO `Verify:` command. They are planned as work but NOT as closable: `close_finding` skips verification when none is declared, so closing them would write `fixed` with an empty `verified_by`. Authoring the verify line is part of the fix.

33 dispatchable finding(s) name NO target and are not planned. A worker cannot be told where to work, and grouping them under one pseudo-key would render as a work unit while spanning unrelated lanes. This is a FILING defect — add a `Location:`/`Target:` line to each — not a task to dispatch.
10 target(s) carry findings from more than one lane; each is planned under the STRONGEST profile of those lanes, never an arbitrary one.
no `wtN` worktree slots exist — Lean and substrate groups cannot be dispatched in isolation. `scripts/setup_lean_worktree_slots.sh` creates them.
